insight.title: You Think Everyone Is Watching You
insight.subtitle: Why you overestimate how much attention others pay to you.
insight.notificationHook: You think people watch you more.

sections.text: You constantly overestimate how much others notice your appearance or actions. Your brain assumes a spotlight is always on you.
This isn't vanity, but a natural self-focus. Your internal experience is always front and center, making it feel equally important to everyone else.
That small stain on your shirt or awkward comment you made felt huge to you, yet barely registered, if at all, to others.
Most people are too busy being watched themselves.
